annotations.title: Read a node in the running game

description:
Read the live properties of one node in the RUNNING game (transform, visibility, physics state...) without stopping it. Paths are absolute; take them from summer_get_runtime_tree.
Guide: summer_docs_read {"id":"tool/inspect-runtime-node"}

maxCharacters.description: Most characters of text to return (default 4000). A longer result is cut and says so.

path.description: Runtime node path, e.g. '/root/Main/Player'. Get it from summer_get_runtime_tree.
